verdict.rationale: Eqvista's own cap-table page states it supports ASC 718 reporting, so the capability is first-party. That is a single marketing line, with no documentation of the expense report contents, export formats, or auditor-ready output. Missing for 10: documented ASC 718 expense report workflow and output (expense schedules, amortization, forfeitures), auditor-ready export or format details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors

citations.quote: Eqvista supports ASC 718 reporting, Rule 701 compliance, and Form 3921 filing as companies scale their equity programs.
